summary: Architecture-only phase opening Track 120. Defines docs/PHASE_120_REPOSITORY_INTELLIGENCE_READ_ONLY_PROTOTYPE_ARCHITECTURE.md, answering how PCAE architecture should support a future read-only Repository Intelligence prototype that generates schema-conforming artifacts from the frozen 119 executable schema line, without execution, mutation, Advisory authority, Decision Evaluation replacement, runtime behavior change, or repository-state authority. Defines nine conceptual prototype stages, eight architectural layers, conceptual input/output models, read-only guarantees, source attribution architecture, Evidence boundary architecture, uncertainty/unknown handling, limitation/disclaimer architecture, boundary disclosure architecture, non-final persistence architecture (three candidate locations proposed for 120B, none chosen), verification architecture (no validators implemented), governance architecture, and failure/no-go conditions. Names Repository Knowledge Snapshot as the first future prototype target, grounded in Phase 118A's read-only production model. Defines the Track 120 roadmap: 120B-120F as committed candidates, 121-125+ as a tentative, unactivated long-range shape. Documents and classifies the three known inherited tooling/reporting issues carried forward from 119AC as non-blocking for architecture, without repairing them. No schema, source, or test file was changed; no generator, validator, CLI, or automated test suite was implemented; no generated artifact was produced.
tests_added_or_updated: None. 120A was an architecture-only phase and did not add automated tests.
track_120_purpose: Defines the architecture for a future read-only Repository Intelligence prototype that may later produce artifacts conforming to the frozen 119 executable schema line, without execution, mutation, Advisory authority, Decision Evaluation replacement, runtime behavior change, or repository-state authority.
relationship_to_119: 119 defines schema shape (12 shared components + 8 artifact-family schemas, frozen and finally reviewed in 119AC). 120 defines the read-only prototype architecture for producing artifacts conforming to those shapes; it does not alter or reinterpret the 119 schemas.
input_model_summary: Conceptual future inputs: committed repository files, phase documents, status files, task memory, schema files, canonical phase reports, governance outputs, and git history/commit metadata. 120A does not read or process any of these beyond architecture review.
output_model_summary: Conceptual future outputs: one artifact per 119 artifact family (Repository Knowledge Snapshot first, then Historical Memory Snapshot, Dependency Knowledge Graph Snapshot, Change Impact Report, Advisory Intelligence Context Package, Query Result, Repository Intelligence Package). 120A creates no generated output artifact.
first_prototype_target: Repository Knowledge Snapshot (schemas/repository_intelligence/artifacts/repository_knowledge_snapshot.schema.json, implemented in 119O), grounded in Phase 118A's read-only production model and the 118 architecture's own dependency ordering (Historical Memory, Dependency Knowledge Graph, and Change Impact Analysis all emerge from or consume Repository Knowledge).
read_only_guarantees_summary: No file mutation outside governed docs/status updates; no source modification; no execution; no shell mediation beyond existing governed commands; no package installation; no network dependency; no runtime plugin change; no Advisory behavior change; no Decision Evaluation replacement; no Evidence truth claim; no Repository State truth claim.
source_attribution_architecture_summary: Every future generated claim must be tied to Source Attribution Records using the frozen 119 locator vocabulary (file_path, file_path_line, file_path_symbol, file_path_section, phase_id, phase_report_id, task_id, commit_sha, tag, release_id, evidence_id, decision_id, contract_document_section, canonical_report_id); an unattributable claim must be represented as unknown or inferred, never asserted as fact.
evidence_boundary_summary: A future generator may reference Evidence only through Evidence Link Records, using evidence_gap_marker when no genuine link exists; must never claim to replace, bypass, or preempt the Evidence subsystem.
uncertainty_unknown_handling_summary: Future artifacts must use the frozen shared uncertainty/verification-state vocabulary (known, unknown, unverified, partially_verified, weak, possible, inferred, advisory_only, decision_required, verified, invalid, stale, superseded, conflicting) and must never perform a prohibited uncertainty collapse.
limitation_disclaimer_architecture_summa: Future artifacts must populate limitation_record entries wherever a generator's method or source coverage has bounds, and must emit all shared and family-specific disclaimer constants verbatim, never paraphrased or omitted.
boundary_disclosure_summary: Every future generated artifact must preserve all nine boundary_disclosure const-true declarations (read_only, no_execution, non_decision, advisory_non_authority, decision_evaluation_required, no_repository_mutation, no_lifecycle_mutation, no_evidence_replacement, no_repository_state_replacement); a generator that cannot honestly declare all nine must not produce an artifact.
persistence_architecture_summary: Conceptual only; no output location chosen. Three candidate locations proposed for 120B's contract freeze to evaluate: .pcae/repository-intelligence/, artifacts/repository-intelligence/, reports/repository-intelligence/. No path created, no file written.
verification_architecture_summary: Later phases should verify future generated artifacts for schema parse, schema conformance (once a validator exists), source attribution completeness, unknown/limitation presence, boundary/disclaimer presence, no-authority, and no-execution. No validator, validation library, or verification CLI implemented in 120A.
governance_architecture_summary: Future prototype phases must remain governed via the existing PCAE lifecycle (task contracts, staged-file-aware commits, task finish, phase complete); no raw git commit/push, no --no-verify, no force push; origin/main..HEAD returned to 0 at the end of every phase; runtime remains Observed/observe throughout.
failure_no_go_conditions_summary: Missing source attribution; generated artifact implies truth/completeness, approval, or execution permission; generator attempts repository mutation, changes source files, invokes Advisory, performs Decision Evaluation, performs graph traversal, performs impact analysis, executes commands, or relies on runtime plugins beyond the observe posture.

advisory_relationship: 120 does not grant Advisory authority. A future generated artifact may become a future Advisory input via the existing Advisory Intelligence Context Package family (119W), but 120A does not implement, invoke, or modify Advisory Runtime or any Advisory subsystem.
decision_evaluation_relationship: 120 does not replace Decision Evaluation. Every 119 schema requires decision_evaluation_required to be declared true, and 120A carries that requirement forward unchanged.
execution_relationship: 120 does not introduce execution. Runtime state remains Observed, maximum plugin capability remains observe, and execution remains unavailable throughout 120A and the entire 120B-120F sequence defined here.
